description: This file is a shell script used for testing the 'git commit' porcelain-like commands and behaviors in the Git project. It includes various test cases for commit message editing, trailers, cleanup options, author/date handling, and other commit-related features.

methods.name: commit_msg_is
methods.description: Checks if the latest commit message matches the expected message.

methods.name: check_summary_oneline
methods.description: Verifies the format of the summary line of a commit message based on git log output.

methods.name: trailer_commit_base
methods.description: Creates a commit with trailers in the message.

methods.name: output_tests_cleanup
methods.description: Performs cleanup operations after certain tests, like resetting branches and removing files.

methods.name: try_commit
methods.description: Attempts to create a commit with optional template and status flags, then checks if certain strings are present.

methods.name: try_commit_status_combo
methods.description: Runs multiple test cases with different combinations of commit status flags.
